findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.vigilbase.com" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: run_security_headers, get_security_badge, search_docs, search, execute_write · Private data: search, execute, execute_write, execute_delete · Public sink: run_email_security, search, execute_write · Destructive: list_security_tools, run_security_headers, run_email_security, search, execute, execute_write, execute_delete.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: run_security_headers, get_security_badge, search_docs, search, execute_write · Private data: search, execute, execute_write, execute_delete · Public sink: run_email_security, search, execute_write · Destructive: list_security_tools, run_security_headers, run_email_security, search, execute, execute_write, execute_delete

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
